snippet.title: Average Human Ball Game Gameplay Trailer #1
snippet.description:
Average Human Ball Game Gameplay Trailer #1

(Gameplay in this video is in Early Access phase)

Available through Early Access on Steam

Face off against your friends in this fast paced combination of a fighting game and sports game. Will you be crowned victor? 
 
Developers: Ultra Hypa Studios
                        Magnus Alferes 
                        Adam Day
